conviction_note: The FY 2025/26 outturn is largely known -- 9M revenue EUR 1,348.6m, EBITDA EUR 386.8m including a EUR 29m one-off licence sale, and the 19-21% margin guidance confirmed on 12 May -- so the news on 23 September is the FY 2026/27 guidance. Both findings are about that guidance and both are negative; they sum to -2.1 and I emit -1.5, because the European beet story is the same one that caused the February cut and this market has already shown it tolerates it (the February cut was reported as 'Gekappte Prognose kein Schock'). Sizing is also held in by the name itself: a 5-analyst SDAX seed company with a cadence-estimated median reaction of 2.09%.
bar: FY 2025/26: comparable net sales at the prior-year level and an EBITDA margin of 19-21% excluding the one-time licence effect, cut from 'around 3% growth' on 12 February 2026 and confirmed at 9M on 12 May 2026. https://www.kws.com/corp/en/media-press/news/financial-results-for-the-first-nine-months-of-2025-2026-kws-remains-on-track-despite-a-challenging-agricultural-environment/
session_check: bmo, confirmed against the issuer's own Finanzkalender rather than the vendor: KWS publishes the FY 2025/2026 results on Wednesday 23 September 2026 at 07:00 CEST, with an analyst call at 09:00. https://www.kws.com/corp/de/investoren/finanzkalender/ . The baseline said bmo on vendor flag -1; the two agree, so the window is the 22 September close to the 23 September close.
positioning_check: The Bundesanzeiger Netto-Leerverkaufspositionen register read for this run (as of 2026-09-17, 283 disclosed positions) and does not name KWS SAAT, so its disclosed net short is 0.0 at the 0.5% public threshold. That is the truncation floor, not a measurement: `anchor_covered` is false on this baseline, there is no positioning anchor, and `short_change_pct_pts` is 0.0 for the same reason. Nothing here says whether anyone is short below 0.5%.

findings.finding: European sugarbeet area is contracting again into the 2027 campaign, and KWS's FY 2026/27 guidance has to be set against it. The EU internal sugar price has fallen more than 30% in a year, from EUR 767/t to EUR 529/t; German beet area fell 12.6% in 2026 to about 338,700 ha; Suedzucker has asked Bavarian growers to stop planting and is cutting contracted area by a similar order again for 2026 and 2027; and the new beet price model for the 2027/28 campaign sets a guaranteed base price well below prior years. Sugarbeet is KWS's highest-margin segment and the February 2026 guidance cut was caused by exactly this mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 12 February 2026 cut on the same line -- 'a greater reduction in global sugarbeet area than previously assumed' -- was absorbed rather than punished; the German wires headlined it 'KWS Saat leidet unter mauem Agrarmarkt - Gekappte Prognose kein Schock'. So this line has moved the stock before and did not move it far.
findings.original_quote: Zuckerkonzerne raten Landwirten weniger Zuckerrueben anzubauen [translation: sugar groups are advising farmers to plant fewer sugarbeet]. Supporting: 'Preissturz bei Zucker: Suedzucker bittet Bayerns Ruebenbauern um Anbau-Stopp' (Bayerisches Landwirtschaftliches Wochenblatt, https://www.wochenblatt-dlv.de/maerkte/preissturz-zucker-suedzucker-bittet-bayerns-ruebenbauern-um-anbau-stopp-582902) and 'Nordzucker in der Krise: Millionenverlust und neues Preismodell fuer Ruebenanbauer' (LAND & FORST, https://www.landundforst.de/betrieb/nordzucker-krise-millionenverlust-neues-preismodell-fuer-ruebenanbauer-575584).
findings.why_not_priced: The transmission is one step removed and the evidence sits in the German farm press and in the processors' grower communications rather than in equity coverage: the sell-side models KWS's seed sales, the processors decide the area, and the growers' price model for 2027/28 is published where growers read it. If this were priced, KWS would not have needed a February cut for the same reason after guiding to 3% growth in the autumn. Five analysts cover the name.
findings.independence: Three independent outlets (agrarheute, Bayerisches Landwirtschaftliches Wochenblatt, LAND & FORST) plus the processors' own statements; the EU price series and the German area figure are separate observations from the grower-price model.

findings.finding: Russia is the second line pointing at the FY 2026/27 guide and it is the one KWS itself named in February. KWS has cited import restrictions and seed-localisation as an expected drag on the Russian business; Russia was EUR 140m of revenue and about 150 staff in FY 2023/24, against group revenue of EUR 1.68bn, and KWS said at the time that how much seed may be imported under the quota was open and that it did not rule out being left out of the quota altogether.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Named as one of the two reasons for the February 2026 revenue cut, alongside sugarbeet area, in a print the market treated as no shock.
findings.original_quote: Wie viel Saatgut ueber die Importquote im kommenden Jahr eingefuehrt werden duerfe, sei offen. KWS schliesst nicht aus, bei den Quoten nicht mehr beruecksichtigt zu werden. [translation: how much seed may be imported under the quota next year is open; KWS does not rule out no longer being considered in the quotas.]
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced and deliberately sized small for a reason that matters: THE SOURCE IS TWO YEARS OLD. The search returned it among 2026 results and the publication date on the article is 26 September 2024. It is used here only for the SIZE of the Russian business as of FY 2023/24 and for the nature of the quota risk, not as evidence about the 2027 quota, which I could not source. No 2026 update on the quota allocation was found.
findings.independence: KWS's own February 2026 statement cites the expected Russian decline as one of the two reasons for the revenue cut (https://www.kws.com/corp/en/media-press/news-2026/kws-publishes-results-for-the-first-half-2025-2026-and-updates-forecast-for-the-fiscal-year/), which is independent of the 2024 article and is what makes the line live.

searched_and_found_nothing: Any ad-hoc or corporate release between the 9M numbers on 12 May 2026 and the print: the EQS-News search archive for this issuer returns only a sustainability release on 2 July 2026, so nothing about the FY has been pre-released -- unlike several German issuers in the same month.
Any 2026 news on the Russian seed import quota allocation for the coming season.
Any disclosed net short position in the Bundesanzeiger register.
A sourced FY 2026/27 consensus for revenue or EBITDA margin: none located, so the bar for the forward guide is unsourced and the findings on it are capped accordingly.
baseline_tension: It cuts WITH the lean, weakly. The baseline's priced_lean_pct is -0.219, which is the 20-day run-up alone (+4.37%) because there is no disclosed short, so my negative agrees with the only directional number in the baseline -- which is a reason to hold the size in, not to raise it. That is why -2.1 of findings is emitted as -1.5.
local_pass_note: The English pass established the bar and the calendar and produced NO finding: 9M revenue, EBITDA and the confirmed 19-21% margin range, the February cut, and the absence of any pre-release. Everything it found was either already in the baseline or already in the price.

Both findings came from the German pass. The sugarbeet area and the 2027/28 grower price model exist only in the German farm press (agrarheute, Bayerisches Landwirtschaftliches Wochenblatt, LAND & FORST); the Russian quota detail and its size came from Boersen-Zeitung.

The German pass is also what caught the trap: the Boersen-Zeitung article the search returned among 2026 results is dated 26 September 2024, which is why finding 2 is sized at -0.6 and labelled rather than used as current evidence.
lessons_applied: NOT A CLEAN FREEZE, and this must not be pooled. This hunt was run by the orchestrating session rather than by an isolated `unpriced-hunter-de` subagent, because this session cannot spawn subagents, and it had read researcher_europe/LESSONS.md before the hunt began. pre_lessons is equal to the emitted set by construction.

The rules that bore on the work: read the date out of the source (it killed the Russian article as current evidence); the hunter's caveat has to reach the number (-2.1 of findings emitted as -1.5 because the sugarbeet line agrees with the lean and has already been absorbed once); and a finding that merely agrees with visible positioning is not a finding.
